title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #053 · 교복 · 크롭 탑 × 사이드 버클 스트랩 초미니 · 힐 · hourglass bombshell · 손허리·턱 · 배경 가을 공원 · 아게하
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, blunt bob dark brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a cropped sleeveless top of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with a rounded Peter Pan collar and a red satin ribbon bow at its center, her shoulders and arms bare, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro mini skirt of ultra-thin matte charcoal-grey modal jersey whose side seam is open and closed only by two thin straps with small gold buckles, her bare hip showing between the straps, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the clean edges of the buckled side straps, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
